title: Chapter 184 Gathering And Scattering Quicksand
content:
Chapter 184 Gathering And Scattering Quicksand

Five days later, Han Fei was ready to go on an envoy to the six kingdoms. Zhong Yu also sent 300 knights to accompany him as guards, and the King of Han also sent 300 people as his escort. Mind!

At the gate of the city, dozens of people came to see Han Fei off.

"Your Highness, it's a long journey, and it's extremely dangerous. I hope you'll take care of it all the way!" The prime minister of South Korea, Zhang Liang's grandfather Zhang Kaidi, was standing at the gate of the city, exhorting Han Fei.

"Don't worry, Prime Minister, Han Fei knows the importance of this journey. How could I, who is related to the fate of the world, die so easily?" Han Fei smiled, seemingly cynical, but his tone was so solemn.

"Your Highness, take care all the way!" As Han Fei's only friend, Zhang Liang didn't say much, but just gave a soft blessing.

"Got it, Zifang, don't you know me?" Han Fei reached out and thumped Zhang Liang's chest, causing her to cough.

Then the other ministers also came up to speak and pestered him for a while.

After finally getting them to disperse, Princess Honglian, who was extremely clingy to Han Fei, ran up again, hugging Han Fei with a crying face, her shoulders kept twitching, obviously crying into tears.

"Okay, Honglian, you've grown up too, how can you still be so childish? Brother, it's not like I won't come back, I just went out for a while, didn't I go to school before?" Han Fei touched Honglian's hand Shoulder, consoled him.

"No, it's different, I know the difference. Brother, this journey is very dangerous, Qin will not let an alliance strong enough to fight against him be born!" Honglian said with a crying voice, sobbing.

"Silly boy, people always have to face danger. Isn't there so many people protecting me all the way? Why worry!" Han Fei smiled wryly.

Seeing that Han Fei seemed to be in trouble, Zhong Yu smiled and walked up.

"Princess Honglian, everyone has a fate to face, which cannot be escaped. For the sake of South Korea, Mr. Han Fei can sacrifice his life, this is something to be happy about, why worry about it!" Beside Han Fei, Zhong Li looked at the red lotus in his arms and said softly.

"No, I don't listen, it's you, there are so many people in South Korea, why choose my brother?" Honglian shook her head, raised her face to look at Zhong Yu, and said bitterly.

"Because Mr. Han Fei is talented enough to take on this mission, and his status is enough to attract the attention of the six countries!" Said his reason calmly, Zhong Yu didn't have the so-called habit of kneeling and licking women.

"Okay, Your Highness, it's getting late, if you delay any longer, you will miss the journey!" Zhong Yu turned to look at Han Fei and said to him.

"Yes, Your Highness, Han Fei is leaving now!" Han Fei nodded and replied in response.

"Okay, Honglian, brother, I'm leaving, you've grown up too, remember to be strong!" Han Fei pushed away Honglian who was hugging him tightly, took a look at him, then turned and left.

Looking at Han Fei's resolutely leaving figure, Honglian's eyes showed sadness, but the tears on her face stopped. She understood that this was the path Han Fei chose, and no one could stop it.

"Everyone has a fate that he should bear. This time he survives in this world, what he has to face is the meaning of its existence, Princess Honglian, it's time for you to understand this truth. No one will just Live for others, even if that person does work for a certain person, like a shadow, but he also has his own belief and meaning of existence!" Zhong Yu looked directly into Honglian's eyes, sharp and piercing, making Honglian's heart ache.

Looking at Princess Honglian who dared not look at her, Zhong Yu smiled. The woman in front of her couldn't see the Chi Lian figure of a decade later, but the entire world was terrified.

Shaking his head, Zhong Yu laughed at himself, what am I thinking now?

The girl in front of her is just a fledgling nestled in the warm arms of her parents. She has never experienced the hatred of ruining the country and the pain of being able to die herself. How can she become a vicious Chi Lian?

"And what you need to do is to find the meaning of your existence, and work hard for that meaning, so that you can get closer and closer to that goal! Then what is your meaning? Your brother, Han who just left you No, or is it South Korea that gave birth to you, or is it yourself?"

Zhong Yu's voice faded away, he didn't have time to waste with this little girl, there was an important guest waiting for him to receive in his home!

...

In the courtyard, winding corridors stand above the small pool. The lotus flowers in the pond are in full bloom, and the golden carps are constantly swimming around the lace, vying for the fish food dropped by Zhong Yu.

"Mr. Wei Zhuang, I have admired your name for a long time, and I only had the chance to meet you today. It really made the lonely king very unbearable!" Zhong Yu said in a rather flat voice.

"Oh, is that so? His Royal Highness King Jin, who is famous all over the world, even knows that I am a man from the mountains. It really makes me feel honored!" Wei Zhuang said equally unevenly.

"I heard that Mr. Guigu inherited the power of this famous school from Guigu. I wonder if that's the case?" Zhong Yu smiled, and Zhong Yu was a little curious. The successors, Gai Nie and Wei Zhuang, seem to be only extremely outstanding in swordsmanship, and have not seen other talents.

"I do come from Ghost Valley. As for the power I have learned, if I don't try it, how can the world understand it!" With a cold snort, Wei Zhuang hated the tone of asking himself this question.

"Really? It seems that Mr. lacks a platform to display his talents. The lonely king invited Mr. to come to our country to take over the post of commander of Jinyiwei Qianhu. I don't know what Mr. wants?" Turning his head, Zhong Yu held tight He stared into Wei Zhuang's eyes.

"Oh, Your Highness has never met me before, but invited me to take up an official position in the imperial kingdom. Why are you so sure that I have this ability?" Wei Zhuang smiled and said with some amusement.

"Because of Gu Wang, I trust the word Guigu. No matter how poor their successors are, they still have certain talents. When I saw Mr. Guigu, I once again affirmed the weight of the word Guiguzi!" Laughed Laugh, Zhong Yu said affirmatively.

"Ghost Valley? These two words gave you trust?" Wei Zhuang shook his head, but did not express his attitude.

"In this world, apart from our Yu Kingdom, there is no other stage where you can really display your talents! Qin is extremely powerful and does not need other people to join. But the six countries in the Kanto region have already fallen, and the country is rotten. , it is difficult to give Mr. a good treatment and strong support!" Zhong Yu said this extremely realistic situation flatly.

"That's right! There is no place in the world for me to use it, Yuguo, is it really possible?" Wei Zhuang sighed.

"As long as you are willing to come, you can use your eyes to see!" Zhong Yu said with a smile.

"Would you like to see it with your own eyes? Forget it, I'll go and see what kind of existence this famous Yuguo is!" Wei Zhuang bowed down to Zhong Yu.
